thread:
Kai Ramirez: Morning team! I'm Kai — excited to join Infra. Quick checklist Qs: laptop arrived and I've enrolled MDM, but I can't access the private VPN. Also who should I ping for Dedicated infra creds? Also two truths/one lie: I ran a marathon, I can juggle chainsaws, I've lived in 3 countries. :grinning:

Omar Shah: hey kai — welcome! Ping @Maya Chen for infra creds. For VPN, check MDM profile -> Settings -> Install VPN cert. If still stuck ping IT.

Tegan Liu: hi Kai! FYI your Okta profile might not yet have the 'dedicated-admin' role, Maya handles that.

IT-bot: SYSTEM: New device enrolled for kai.ramirez@redwood.ai. VPN cert: pending. Follow link to complete: https://mdm.redwood.ai/complete

Kai Ramirez: thanks! clicking now. Also small ask: does anyone have a stickers pack? :stickers:

Julia Park: welcome! we have a sticker run next week — DM me your address. Also @Omar can add you to the infra channel.

Maya Chen: adding you to the infra-ops and dedicated-admin groups now. Give it ~5 mins then try `ssh deploy@redwood` — if you get permission denied, say so here.

Kai Ramirez: ok tried ssh — permission denied. output:
```
Permission denied (publickey).
```

Omar Shah: hm, you probably need an SSH key uploaded to your Okta profile. Run `ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "kai@redwood.ai"` then paste the public key into Okta. Ping me if want a quick screen share.

Kai Ramirez: added key, trying again... success! 🎉 Thanks everyone. Two truths/one lie — guess which one is false?

Tegan Liu: chainsaws seems suspect but you never know :eyes:

Julia Park: marathon is believable, chainsaws is the lie? final answer: chainsaws 😅

Kai Ramirez: correct — chainsaws is the lie. happy to be here — excited to pair on infra stuff next week :)
